ModInfo.description:
[h1]Choose your ruler's first strength instead of rolling it.[/h1]
With [b]Leader = Pick Later[/b] and [b]Customize Leader off[/b], your ruler no longer starts with a random strength trait. On [b]turn 2[/b] you get the familiar Promote popup and pick one yourself.
Your archetype choice and your ratings are untouched.
[h1]What you get[/h1] [list] [*][b]Turn 1[/b] — you found your capital and pick your archetype. An event, [i]The Measure of a King[/i] (or Queen), tells you the choice is coming. [*][b]Turn 2[/b] — the Promote popup offers [b]four traits[/b] and no rating options. [/list]
[b]Leader with no job[/b] — four free picks. [b]Leader already a general, explorer or governor[/b] — the stock level-up shape: three traits for that job plus one from the other pool.
[h1]Any archetype, any trait[/h1] The base game gates twelve of the thirty-three level-up traits on a rating, and archetypes set ratings. A Zealot (Wisdom -1) can never take Intelligent or Cunning; a Schemer loses Warlike, Brave and Fierce; an Orator loses Prosperous, Frugal, Vigilant and Strict.
This mod lifts that, so every ruler draws from the same thirty-three — the freedom the leader customizer already gives you, without the rest of the customizer.
[h1]Multiplayer: the same menu for everyone[/h1] Every player is offered the [b]identical four traits, in the same order[/b], and the menu does not depend on whose turn is processed first. The game is decided by the choice, not the roll.
This restores something the base game already does for the trait being replaced: in competitive two-team games it copies an opposing ruler's strength trait so both sides start alike.
[h1]Notes[/h1] [list] [*]Everyone in a multiplayer game needs the mod enabled. [*]Players using a fixed archetype, a preset leader, or the leader customizer are unaffected. [*]No base game files are changed. Built and tested against 1.0.84365. [/list]
[b]Source:[/b] https://github.com/alcaras/OldWorld-Turn2StartingTrait
